quote: What I valued most was that the first consultation was almost an hour. Nobody had previously asked me about my sleep, my diet or my thyroid history — they had only looked at my scalp.
author: Meera S.

quote: I live in Dubai and consult online. Reports are uploaded before the call, the prescription arrives afterwards and the medicines reach me within the week. It has been genuinely practical.
author: Fathima N.

quote: Dr. Riji told me at the first visit that part of my greying was genetic and would not reverse. I appreciated being told that rather than being sold a package.
author: Rahul M.

quote: My daughter is seven and was anxious about seeing any doctor. The consultation was unhurried and she was spoken to directly rather than about. That mattered more than I expected.
author: Anjali R.

quote: The follow-up photographs are what convinced me. I could not judge my own progress month to month, but the comparison at six months was clear.
author: Divya K.

quote: I was asked to get thyroid and ferritin tests before any medicine was prescribed. It turned out my ferritin was very low. That alone changed things.
author: Sreelakshmi P.
context: Consulting since 2026 · Hair fall with anaemia
